title: Atlas (orchestrator)
summary: Technical spec for Atlas, the root orchestrator/supervisor that schedules cron runs, routes the Wire queue, sequences the morning pipeline, enforces gates, and escalates failures.
scope: Cloudflare Cron Triggers / Workflows / Queues / Durable Objects / D1 / KV
notes: Prose-heavy agent description but carries concrete implementation contracts (Wire event shape {agent,type,entity,op,payload,idempotencyKey}, flag schema, retry/timeout tables, schedule trigger table, config contracts), so classified SPEC over DOC. Not ADR (no Decision/Consequences) or PRD (no user stories/acceptance criteria). Repeatedly defers authority to SPEC-CANON sections (§) and ../03-scheduling.md, consistent with a derived spec doc.
